payload.title: Uniform time sampling with Pyleoclim
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates methods for achieving uniform time sampling in paleoclimate data using the Pyleoclim library. It addresses the common issue of uneven time spacing in paleosciences by exploring interpolation, binning, resampling, and Gaussian kernel coarsening techniques. The notebook uses data from Jouzel et al. (2007) and provides visualizations to compare the effectiveness of each method. The goal is to familiarize users with time regridding methods in Pyleoclim.
goals: Become familiar with time regridding methods in Pyleoclim
